messages:
Priya: Quick sync 1010 We're launching a compact pricing calculator experiment tomorrow AM. Aim: reduce cognitive load on pricing page and increase 'Request demo' quality.
Omar: Nice. What's the exact CTA behavior? keep same modal?
Priya: Two options: inline estimate CTA (shows instant estimate) + "Request demo" button below. If user clicks Request demo after using calculator, we'll prefill the form with estimated monthly cost.
Leah: Good for sales context. For routing: tag leads with `calc_expt_compact_v1`. If prefiller estimate >$5k/mo -> route to AE-Sales; else AE-SDR.
Vik: tracking: GA event `compact_calc_interaction`, and `prefill_used` boolean. Add `utm_experiment=compact_calc_v1` to URLs.
ProductBot: preview build: https://preview.redwood.dev/pricing?utm_experiment=compact_calc_v1 (build 1902).
Priya: Copy variant A (short): "Estimate monthly inference cost in seconds." CTA: "Get estimate". Variant B (numbers-first): shows 3 quick examples then CTA: "See your estimate".
Omar: I prefer B - examples anchor expectations. Also add microcopy under model tier: "Higher quality models cost more per token."
Leah: FAQ changes: convert to micro-tooltips instead of long Q&As. Suggested tooltips: "How do you calculate?" -> "Uses tokens/day x model rate + latency buffer." and "Do you keep my data?" -> "Request data ephemeral by default." Need legal review for that last line.
Priya: Already submitted to legal; they approved the phrasing 'ephemeral by default' with a note to link to full privacy page.
Vik: Accessibility note: ensure the inline estimate is announced via ARIA live region and the prefiller is keyboard-focusable. Event `tooltip_open` should capture which FAQ tip was opened.
Omar: Roll plan: 7 days at 15% traffic, 50/50 variants, check on day 3 for early signal. Metrics: demo CTR, demo conversion to MQL, avg time-on-pricing. Baseline demo CTR = 2.8% (last 30d). Target lift = +1.2pp.
Leah: If demo CTR improves but MQL quality drops, we should keep inline estimates but change form prefill behavior.
Priya: Good guardrail. Also linking webinar: "Cost optimization clinic" CTA will appear for users estimating >$2k/mo. Clicking signs them up to a 20-minute webinar. We want to capture attendance and follow-up interest.
Vik: Webinar tracking: registration event `webinar_reg_from_calc`, attendance event `webinar_attend_costs`. Add UTM `calc_webinar`.
ProductBot: Benchmark dataset note: AJ uploaded latency vs cost curves for 3 common workloads to /assets/benchmarks/cost_latency_v2.csv. Use that for webinar slide deck.
Priya: Who can own the benchmark narrative? Need 2 slides: 1) cost vs latency tradeoffs for chat vs summarization; 2) how calculator projects monthly spend for small/medium/large workloads.
Omar: I'll draft slide 1. Leah will do slide 2 with 3 customer persona examples.
Leah: Will include a short CTA script for AEs if they follow up: "Here's the estimated monthly spend we saw plus optimization levers (batching, quantization, model routing)."
Priya: Final checklist: design final sign-off, legal ok (done), dev acceptance, analytics hook. Plan flip: tomorrow 9:00am PT to 15% traffic. If by day 7 we hit target lift and no uptick in support tickets, promote to 50% and schedule webinar next Wed.
Vik: I'll monitor accessibility and GA events; will post a daily slack update in #marketing-rollouts.
Priya: Thanks all. Ping me if anything blocks. :rocket:
